Configured the DNS hierarchy: pc1–pc13 serve the requested zones, pc14 is the recursive resolver, and pc16–pc20 use pc14. BIND configuration and startup files were added, and the DNS servers’ images were changed to `kathara/bind` in [lab.conf](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-d91t3skn/lab/lab.conf).

Assumed `www.example.com` points to pc4 (`10.14.1.14`), since its address was unspecified. Basic static checks passed; BIND validation tools were unavailable locally, and runtime resolution was not tested.
